title: Amethyst OPickaxe
description: A powerful 3x3 pickaxe inspired by DonutSMP, with amethyst particles and sounds. Mine walls or flat areas depending on where you look!
body:
This mod adds a powerful pickaxe called the Amethyst OPickaxe, inspired by the legendary pickaxe from the DonutSMP server. 

When used, it mines a full 3x3 area. Each block broken releases purple amethyst particles and plays a random amethyst sound for a satisfying mining experience. 

Craft it and unlock the exclusive achievement "Ready to find stash?". 

Requires Fabric API. 

Crafting recipe: ![Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a64d23ca9c7f0cd7d960bb221c1f39eb6e11be51.png)
